name: MedReason
description: MedReason is a large-scale, high-quality medical reasoning dataset designed to enable faithful and explainable medical problem-solving in large language models. It provides 32,682 question-answer pairs with detailed, step-by-step explanations derived from a structured medical knowledge graph, validated for clinical logic and evidence-based medicine.
reputation: A newly released medical reasoning dataset that is promising for explainable clinical QA, but it has not yet seen broad community adoption as a standard benchmark.
notes: Dataset is constructed by converting clinical QA pairs into logical chains of reasoning using a medical knowledge graph; validated by medical professionals.
